text: ざんねんだが　おまえの　でばんは　まったく　ねーぜ！

structure.jp: おまえの　でばんは

patterns.name: 〜が (but)
patterns.explanation: が at the end of a sentence part means 'but'. ざんねんだが = 'it's a pity, but'.

patterns.name: まったく〜ない
patterns.explanation: まったく with a 'not' word means 'not at all'. ねー is a rough way to say ない. まったく　ねー = 'there's none at all'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is a rough, boyish way to push what you say. ねーぜ = 'there ain't any!'
